bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (screenshot markup editor), springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (canvas app), springboard/ui/src/markup.rs (pure markup document model: elements, ids, undo and redo, save and reload), springboard/sdk/src/print.rs and springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (no markup API)
summary: PaperKit is an app-facing markup framework: view controllers, a vector-style markup data model with shapes, text, images, links and a loupe, and a feature set. BifrOSt has freehand drawing (pen, marker, pencil, eraser, colours, undo) in the shell's screenshot editor and in the Freeform app, both flattened to PNG. A pure document model now holds shapes, text boxes, images, links and loupes with stable ids, redo, and a text save form, but nothing draws or edits those elements yet and no SDK markup API exposes them.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (Markup struct, touch, draw); opened from springboard/src/shell/mod.rs:3782 and :3801
features.note: Shell-only editor for screenshot captures. Apps get no view controller or SDK type for it.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:20 (Tool: Pen, Marker, Pencil, Eraser), :29 (brush widths and opacity); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs:42 (Tool: Pen, Marker, Eraser)
features.note: Stroke widths and opacity are fixed per tool. No stylus pressure, tilt or stroke editing. Strokes are not yet elements of springboard/ui/src/markup.rs.

features.feature: Undo and redo for markup edits
features.apple: Undo of markup changes through the view controller and its undo manager
features.note: The document model has undo and redo with a bounded history. The shell and Freeform still have undo only, and neither uses the model.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs:140 (bar: tool buttons, colour well, Undo, Clear, Save)
features.note: The Freeform toolbar offers drawing tools only. No menu inserts shapes, text, images or links into a canvas.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/markup.rs (ShapeMarkup, ShapeKind: Rectangle, Ellipse, Line, TextBox; insert, replace, remove, reorder by MarkupId); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:252 (disc, raster stamp); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs:215 (stamp, raster)
features.note: The model keeps shapes and text boxes as selectable, restylable data with ids. Nothing draws them or lets a person create them on screen; the on-screen marks are still raster stamps.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/markup.rs (ImageMarkup: frame and asset source); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:55 (Markup holds the captured base image; drawn under the strokes)
features.note: The model can hold an image element that names an asset. Nothing places one on a canvas on screen, and the captured screenshot is still the only image in the shell editor.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/markup.rs (LinkMarkup: frame and url; LoupeMarkup: frame and magnification at least 1)
features.note: The model holds link and loupe elements with validation. No tap handling, no magnification rendering and no MarkupInteractions equivalent exist yet.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/markup.rs (MarkupDocument: ordered elements with MarkupId, encode and decode text form, next-id persistence); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (strokes in memory, flattened on Done); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs:336 (save writes a flattened PNG to the Photos folder)
features.note: The document model saves and reloads elements with their ids and order, and rejects damaged saved files. The shell and Freeform still save a flattened PNG and discard strokes, so no app uses the saved form yet.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/markup.rs (MarkupError: UnknownId, InvalidFrame, InvalidValue, Decode with line number); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs:336 (save returns Result<String, String>)

gaps: No app-facing SDK markup API: no view controller, no shared type exported to apps. Apps cannot embed a markup canvas.

The document model in springboard/ui/src/markup.rs has no renderer and no pointer input, so shapes, text boxes, images, links and loupes cannot be drawn or created on screen; every on-screen mark is still a raster stamp.
The shell and Freeform still save a flattened PNG and discard the strokes; the model's text save form is not used by any app.
No redo in the shell or Freeform, no stroke selection or editing, no stylus pressure or tilt.
No insertion menu, no feature set, rendering options or HDR, and no auto-resizing policy exposed to apps.
